text:
Priyanka Rao: Morning team — on day 2 and hitting a 403 when loading Redwood Console (prod). Browser shows a blank 'Loading...' spinner and network tab shows GET /api/flags 403.
Priyanka Rao: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags returns {"error":"forbidden","message":"missing_console_role:console-ops"}. Do new hires need a special role or VPN? Also my MFA push keeps timing out.
Devon (Infra): Welcome Priyanka! :wave: New hires usually get console-read via JIT. missing_console_role with console-ops means you don't have the operator role (that's for flag writes). Start by completing the MFA approval on your SSO device; tokens are blocked until MFA completes. Share your SSO email and I'll open a JIT.
Priyanka Rao: priyanka.rao@redwood.ai
Access Bot: Access request created: ONB-9921 by Devon (Infra). Approvers: eng-leads, infra. Link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/ONB-9921
Devon (Infra): I triggered the JIT. If the MFA push times out try resending from the SSO portal or use the recovery code. If that still fails we can send a one-time code. After JIT approval, clear cookies and retry. If blocked, run: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags 2>&1 | grep x-request-id
```
Priyanka Rao: MFA succeeded after I re-sent the push. Ran the curl and got x-request-id: rq_aa77f0 but flags API still 403 for prod keys (staging is fine).
Hannah (Security): Hi @Priyanka  — prod has project scoping plus an IP allowlist for some admin endpoints. Read-only console access typically works without allowlist; write paths require ff-operator and sometimes a maintenance allowlist. If you need write access for your demo we can issue a short-lived ff-operator role.
Devon (Infra): I added you to org:product console-read-scoped for the relevant project. Try logging out and back in (to refresh session scopes). If you're behind corp proxy you might also need HTTP_PROXY set; otherwise you can use this tunnel as a quick workaround: 
```
ssh -L 9443:console.internal:8443 devon@bastion
# then open https://localhost:9443 and re-login
```
Mika (DevEx): If you want to flip a flag for your onboarding demo I can create a temporary ff-operator role for 15 minutes. DM me the flag key and the window. For automation/service accounts, include scopes, owner, expiry and rotation plan in the request; security prefers a rotation cadence (e.g., rotate keys every 30 days).
Priyanka Rao: Logged out/in and session refreshed — prod flags visible now. I'll DM Mika: flag key is 'new_ui_beta' for a 10-minute demo at 11:30 PT. Thank you all :tada:
Hannah (Security): Note for later: service account requests must include justification and a rotation plan. Read-only SAs with a 90-day expiry are auto-approved; write scopes need manual review.
Priyanka Rao: Great, closing the loop. Appreciate the quick help!
